t: The slender tower rising above you is the BT Tower, in Fitzrovia. It was built in 1964 as a communications tower, and has been called the Museum Radio Tower, the Post Office Tower and the Telecom Tower, before taking its current name in 1991. It's Grade II listed. Its architect was Eric Bedford, who was Chief Architect on the project, with G R Yeats as senior architect in charge. At a hundred and seventy-seven metres, it was for a time London's tallest building.
